meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上技能后，Claude能操控浏览器完成打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据等操作；页面状态会保留，多个步骤可连续执行，复杂任务会拆成小脚本分步完成。
howto.when: 当用户要求浏览网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作，或提出其他网页自动化请求时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存
say.note: 浏览器打开页面后截图，文件存到 tmp 目录。

say.text: 点击页面上叫“登录”的按钮
say.note: 根据页面元素定位并执行点击。

say.text: 抓取当前页面的所有文章标题
say.note: 提取页面中的标题列表并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, etc. Page state persists across steps, and complex tasks are broken into small scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to browse pages, fill forms, take screenshots, or makes other browser automation requests.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves a screenshot to tmp.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles from the current page.
